notes: Edges are relationship primitives. Every record conforms to docs/equity_module/v0.1/equity_registry_shared_metadata.schema.json (object_family=edge_type). Endpoints (from_entity_type/to_entity_type) must resolve to records in equity_entity_types.json. Dynamic edges (ownership, peer membership, classification) carry as_of; static edges (share-class of company) carry created_at only.

records.description: Edge linking an operating company to an equity security it issues. Authoritative source is the issuer-of-record disclosure in registration filings.
Edge from an equity_security to one of its exchange listings.
Edge from a share_class to the company whose equity rights it represents.
Edge from an ADR to its foreign underlying equity_security. Mandatory for ADR coverage.
Sector/industry/subindustry classification edge. Vintaged because classifications drift; use as_of for backtests.
Hierarchical edge from an industry to its parent sector.
Hierarchical edge from a subindustry to its parent industry.
Methodology-bound peer relationship between two companies (Bhojraj-Lee or Hoberg-Phillips). Carries similarity_score and methodology.
Competitive relationship between two companies. Distinct from peer (peer is methodology-bound; competitor is operational).
Supply-chain edge: source company supplies destination company. Mirror of customer edge.
Supply-chain edge: source company is a customer of destination company. Inverse of supplier edge.
Filed ownership record (13F / 13D / 13G / Form 4). Always pinned to filing_accepted_at; 13F-derived edges must NOT be used as current positioning.
Section 16 reporting affiliation. Insider role disclosed in DEF 14A / Form 3.
Executive officer service relationship. Disclosed in DEF 14A and 8-K Item 5.02.
Director / board member service relationship.
Filing-to-event linkage (8-K Items 1.01–9.01, 4.02 restatement, 5.02 departures, 13D, etc.). Authoritative timestamp for event availability.
Edge from an event to a security it materially affects. Many-to-many (one event can affect multiple securities; one security can have many events).
Edge linking a thesis to supporting evidence (filings, transcripts, news, valuation models, etc.). Inverse exists as a contradiction edge in the insight engine.
Decision-to-thesis linkage. A decision must reference at least one thesis (or explicit no-action rationale).
Edge from a valuation model to each of its declared assumptions. Required for sensitivity tables and reverse-DCF inversion.
Edge from a valuation model to each scenario it evaluates (bull/base/bear, regime-specific, etc.).
Portfolio-to-position membership. User-private; never exported without explicit user action.
Position-to-security linkage. Required for portfolio valuation and risk decomposition.
Macro-to-sector sensitivity edge (rates → financials, oil → energy, etc.). Used for regime overlays.
Polymorphic edge from a validation_record to any registered object (graph, node, attribute, event, insight, profile, output, package). Append-only.
Edge from a recommendation to the thesis (or theses) it relies on. Required so recommendation_inconsistent_with_thesis rule can fire.
Edge from an analyst provider to the estimate it published.
Edge from a consensus_snapshot to the individual estimates it aggregates.
Authoritative regulator-to-company relationship (e.g., SEC regulates US issuers; FDA regulates drug developers).
Edge from an audit_proof to the `.viza` package it certifies (proof_checksum binding).
Polymorphic edge from a configured connector to filings/transcripts/news/estimates/macro_vintage/etc. Records connector entitlement at ingestion time.
Edge from a data_quality_warning to the target observation/entity it flags.
Edge from a user_memo to its authoring user. Anchors privacy and retention policy.
Polymorphic edge from a watchlist to monitored entities (security/company/event/thesis).
Edge from a vintage (as-of) record to its parent macro series. Each macro_series has one current row + N vintaged rows.
Edge from a strategy- or portfolio-bound benchmark to its underlying provider index. Vintaged because index composition changes.
Polymorphic edge from a `.viza` package to objects it carries (graph/output/evidence_refs/proofs). Marketplace_draft redacts restricted objects.
